question: Where is the 34th ITTF-ATTU Asian Cup table tennis tournament being held?
solution:
The correct answer is China

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Asian Cup 2025 table tennis tournament begins in Shenzhen, China**, at the Universiade Sports Center

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **34th edition of the ITTF-ATTU Asian Cup**, featuring **men’s and women’s singles events with 32 players each**.
 
• **Top four semi-finalists in both categories qualify for the ITTF World Cup 2025**, scheduled for April.
 
• **India’s men’s squad led by world No. 42 Sharath Kamal**, a five-time Olympian and reigning Commonwealth Games champion.
 
• **Manav Thakkar (world No. 60) and Harmeet Desai (world No. 70)** complete the Indian men’s contingent.
 
• **Star player Manika Batra misses the tournament due to injury**, replaced by **Yashaswini Ghorpade**.
 
• **Paris 2024 Olympian Sreeja Akula (world No. 29) and Ayhika Mukherjee (world No. 77) complete the women’s squad**.
 
• **Chetan Baboor won silver (1997) and bronze (2000), while Batra secured bronze in 2022**.
 
• **Defending champions: Tomokazu Harimoto (Japan) in men’s and Wang Yidi (China) in women’s category**.
